headlines.description: Right back Achraf Hakimi claimed a first career hat-trick and provided two assists as Ligue 1 leaders Paris Saint-Germain came from behind to thrash bottom club Le Havre 5-1.
headlines.shortLinkText: Hakimi hat trick fuels PSG rout of Le Havre
